description:
Guardrail G10. Delete targets: pr-arm-auto-merge, pr-conflict-scan, pr-content-guard, pr-fanout, pr-followup-record, pr-followup-resume, pr-landing-ready, pr-landing-start, pr-landing-withdraw, pr-refresh, pr-review-followups, pr-review-followups-list, pr-status, local-validation, local-validation-path, local-validation-show, soundness-drain-report, soundness-drain-self-test, dev-loop-metrics, guards-fix, lane-isolation-check, test-unlock.
Add tier targets: `make check` (T0), `make test` (T1 local for touched units), `make test-queue` (T2 local mirror), keep `make ci-linux` as a thin Docker wrapper for macOS hosts. pr-preflight*, pr-open, pr-ready, ci-docs, ci-linkcheck, ci-lint, ci-local, ci-test become aliases that print their replacement and run it, for one release.
Same PR: update AGENTS.md (write closeout currently mandates make pr-preflight/pr-open/pr-ready and make ci-linux on macOS), CONTRIBUTING.md, .claude/commands/pr.md, docs/development/testing.md, and the skill-sync SOURCE for the benchbox, code, test, and todo skills (not the generated .claude/skills mirror), then re-sync.
